slides.title: Nobody Talks About the Portfolio Gap
slides.subtitle: One thing separates hired from overlooked

bullets: Build a small project - even a home lab writeup
Document what you learned and how you thought
Post it somewhere recruiters can actually find it
Let your work speak before your CV does

caption: Every cyber employer wants proof you can do the job - not just that you studied for it. Your portfolio is that proof. Start building today. #cybersecurity #cybersecuritycareers #cypherjobs #jobsearch #infosec
